groups.talkText: I'm reporting to you live from the University Science Museum. They've recently opened up a fantastic new exhibit on the first floor. From what I understand, the idea behind the exhibit came from Hazam Feras. Mr. Feras develops exhibits at various institutions around the world. I can see why he's in high demand! This latest exhibit of his allows patrons to explore outer space. It starts with the simulated thrill of rocket ship liftoff and continues as you experience traveling around the planets, watching the mysteries of outer space unfold around you.

groups.talkText: Hello and good morning. It's great to see so many people here at the Overlook Community Center for our weekly health and wellness program. We have a treat for you today! Our special guest presenter is Susana Adachi, a yoga and meditation expert. You may not be familiar with her work, but she has won multiple awards! Ms. Adachi is excited to share with you her knowledge and insights about how yoga can improve your life. Now, as we prepare to begin the program, please roll out your yoga mats in front of you.

groups.talkText: We're proud of our windows here at National Window Retailers. We offer a wide variety of windows from the country's largest manufacturers so that our customers won't have to shop around anywhere else. We guarantee that with our large inventory, you will always find the right product for your needs. Our competitors can't beat that. Right now, go to our Web site to take advantage of a special limited-time discount only available online. But hurry, this offer ends soon!

groups.talkText: Good morning everyone, and welcome to this training session on my company's database software. I'm Francesca Romero with Global Medical, and I'll be facilitating this session. We're excited to continue providing your patients with the highest quality care by helping keep accurate records for your doctors and nurses. Let's start first by logging in to the Web site with the username and automatically generated password you were provided via e-mail earlier this week. Once you've logged in, please update your password, adhering to the requirements noted on the page.

groups.talkText: On July fifth, the town of Pennington will host its annual music festival in Maple Park, and the organizers are seeking volunteers from our community to help make the event a success. On June twelfth, there will be auditions for local musicians at the town recreation center. The organizers would like you to help select which acts will perform onstage. If you're interested in helping out, please e-mail musicfest@mymail.com with your name and phone number.

groups.talkText: I'd like to update the product development team on the results of our focus group. Each participant smelled our new scented soaps and filled out a card to tell us what they thought. People in the focus group loved our fruit aromas, like strawberry and lemon. A few fragrances, however, were a bit less popular. Most of the participants noted that they didn't like tree scents like pine, and they felt that the outdoor scents like ocean breeze were too strong. Management would like us to develop additional fragrances instead of these.

groups.talkText: Hello, this message is for Mr. Kwon at Quality Furniture Company. This is Jessica Robertson from Salazar Supply. I'm calling about the metal drawer handles that you ordered last week. I know you were expecting the handles this morning, and they're on the delivery truck now. But, I just spoke to the driver, and he has several more stops to make on his route. Sorry for the inconvenience. Oh, and by the way, thank you for paying electronically. We had a little difficulty with our payment processing, but yours was received on time.

groups.graphic: Trail map: Start at Chamberlain Trail, splits into Fowler Trail (left, past Forest), Hanover Trail (straight to End), and Walnut Trail (right, past Castle)
groups.talkText: Welcome, hikers! Today, your self-guided journey will begin along Chamberlain Trail. After a short hike on that trail, you'll come to a place where it splits in three. The trail on the right leads to the ruins of a castle that was built hundreds of years ago. The left trail takes you along a forest. Continue straight ahead only if you're an experienced hiker—there's rugged terrain along that trail. Now, there's a drinking fountain in the visitor's center. I recommend filling your bottles before you start.

choices.D: It is next to a waterfall.

groups.graphic: Meeting Schedule, October 2: 9:00 A.M. Editorial Department, 11:00 A.M. Sales, 2:00 P.M. Marketing and Advertisement, 4:00 P.M. Publishing
groups.talkText: Good morning, Ms. Madan. This is your assistant, Olivier. I e-mailed you today's meeting schedule. The purpose of the meeting with the editorial department is to discuss a publishing delay. Producing the article about Lauren Mitchell's philanthropic efforts ran into difficulties, unfortunately. Apparently, Ms. Mitchell had to change her availability last minute, which required me to reschedule her photo shoot. We could shift to one of our reserve articles to address the problem. I'd be happy to assist you with finding a suitable one.
